protocol.scope: Local synthetic CPU engineering diagnostics; no production or tenfold claim
protocol.ordering: Rotate implementation order between repetitions; every command uninstrumented
protocol.batch: Same 30 materialized-equivalent K23/N30 fits, same worker count for C processes and Rust threads; 27 finite and 3 retained pathologies, mechanics-only timing
protocol.memory: Per-process Linux maximum RSS and 10ms sampled summed child-tree RSS; sampled sum includes time wrappers and excludes Python harness

limitations: Shared host, no CPU isolation or governor changes; load averages recorded.
Synthetic inputs and few repetitions do not establish portable performance.
The user's real inputs, preprocessing, settings and worker budget remain unavailable.
K64/N5 is a partial trajectory; the 30-fit batch contains three reference pathologies.
Process parallelism is compared at equal worker counts and reported separately from single-fit improvement.
No CUDA or equivalent-mode inference tested.

current_reproducer.note: Three evidence-integrity guards were corrected after this run. Exact measured runner remains separately preserved; the post-run audit proves active measurements satisfy all guards.
